title: Clamp does not keep numbers under the maximum
summary: `clamp(value, low, high)` should return `low` if `value` is below `low`, `high` if `value` is above `high`, otherwise `value` itself. Right now `clamp(5, 0, 10)` returns `10` instead of `5`.
hint: Read the comparison for the upper limit out loud. Is it asking the right question?
